answer: The fable log keeps the sampled set and the penalty so the deterrent is verifiable. Because selection is random and the lotus seed is unrevealed until close, an attacker cannot dodge the sample, so colluding to grade clones' junk is a hollow gamble with a negative expected value. A random sample of settled verdicts is re-graded by an independent panel each epoch, and a divergence found on re-check burns the original grader 21% of its standing plus a seat ban. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
